prompts.task: Read the loaded otel-verify skill and its shared ../references/splunk-agent-observability.md and ../references/scripts/observe_report.py. This is a bounded supplemental destination-contract review, not the whole-service workflow. Do not execute code, call cloud/models, install packages, or modify app/config/canonical artifacts. Write only ./service/.observe/ao-name-input-review.md and .json. For each case give concrete visible field values, whether a new report command is executable, its exact AO arguments when valid, retained saved-target behavior, creation permissions and remaining proof: (A) new selected AO callback-only work, no destination; (B) same selection, only project name checkout; (C) both names checkout and checkout-stream, callback-only work with resource findings unselected; (D) both names with both resource findings selected, first both resources exist then stream missing; (E) saved project_id project-123 and agent_stream_id stream-123 with create_if_missing false; (F) same saved selection after the user enters both names; (G) no AO findings selected with retained name values. Explain compatibility without mutating saved selection or digests by rendering. Distinguish newly generated name inputs from existing validated ID-based CLI/selection runs. Describe the expected field errors, absence of dropdowns and reuse checkbox, and behavior across deselection/reselection. Propose role-appropriate acceptance steps; this static review supplies no browser, provisioning, telemetry or cloud proof. Add case H: an existing validated selection has project_id project-123, agent_stream_name checkout-stream and create_if_missing false. Explain its initial visible name fields and field-scoped blocker, preserved mixed selectors/digest, accepted existing CLI arguments, and the new report command after the user supplies only the missing Project name checkout. Preserve the existing stream name and creation prohibition; no additional resource work is selected. Add case I: an existing schema-v3 selection carries only create_if_missing false from select --ao-reuse-only. Explain normalization versus readiness, the missing-input prompt, how the user supplies both names while retaining this policy and selected IDs, and the resulting command. No environment/default target may satisfy missing user selections.

rubric: New report inputs are exactly Project name and Agent Stream name, required for all selected AO including callback-only work. No name/ID dropdown or Reuse existing resources only checkbox is proposed. A/B block executable commands with only actually missing fields invalid, C/D use --ao-project checkout --ao-agent-stream checkout-stream and preserve requested/dependency-closed scope.

Creation follows selected resource scope: C does not authorize provisioning; D reuses exact existing resources without creates and creates only the selected missing stream in the resolved project. Names, input edits and report rendering never select extra findings or prove resource existence. Authentication and lookup failures are not absence.

E leaves unavailable name fields blank with a legacy-ID explanation and blocks a new report command. Rendering preserves the old saved IDs, create_if_missing false and original digest. Existing validated ID-based runs remain consumable with lookup-only IDs; unresolved IDs do not create replacements. F generates name flags plus --ao-reuse-only to retain the saved restriction without restoring the removed checkbox or silently enabling creation.

G hides destination controls and omits AO flags without erasing entered values; reselecting AO restores values and required validation. Output separates static predictions from fresh browser/application/cloud proof and stays within supplemental artifacts. No credential collection, resource creation or unrelated source/config changes.

For mixed-selector case H, leaves Project name blank and shows the existing Agent Stream name checkout-stream; blocks a new report command only for the missing Project name. Rendering preserves the saved project_id, stream name, false creation policy and original selection digest. Existing validated mixed ID/name CLI runs remain supported; supplying Project name checkout generates --ao-project checkout --ao-agent-stream checkout-stream --ao-reuse-only without mutating saved scope, enabling creation or asking again for the known stream name.

For policy-only case I, distinguishes supported readable saved/CLI policy from a ready new run: both Project and Agent Stream must be supplied, the prompt asks for both and waits, and the same selected IDs and false creation policy survive rebinding. After supplied names checkout and checkout-stream the command includes --ao-project checkout --ao-agent-stream checkout-stream --ao-reuse-only. Describes reuse-only as a CLI/saved policy, never as an available report control or a substitute for required user inputs; no environment/default fallback or scope expansion.
